integrity: Direct mathematical proof with two independently replayable standalone Python verification programs; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth ordered conic pairs over odd-characteristic finite fields with geometric intersection divisor \(3P+Q\), \(P\ne Q\). All vertices and tangent lines must be base-field rational; no assertion for other contact types, characteristic two, or non-simple closure cycles. The finite checks are corroborative, not infinite proofs.
title: Rational Poncelet \(p\)-gons for conics with triple contact
